title: Pet constructor
description: Create a Mascota class with 3 constructors: full, name-only, and empty with default values.
hints: Use this() as the first line
solutionExplanation: Constructor overloading with this() to reuse initialization.
expectedOutput:
Max | Perro | 5
Luna | Unspecified | 0
Unknown | Unspecified | 0

title: Constructor with validation
description: Create a CuentaBancaria class that validates in the constructor that the initial balance is not negative.
hints: Validate: if (saldo < 0) show an error and use 0
solutionExplanation: Constructors with validation protect the integrity of the object.
expectedOutput:
María | Balance: $500.0
Error: balance cannot be negative. $0 used
Carlos | Balance: $0.0
Ana | Balance: $0.0

title: Product system with constructor inheritance
description: Create two classes: Producto and ProductoDigital. ProductoDigital inherits from Producto and adds descargaMax.
hints: super(nombre, precio) calls the Producto constructor
Order: super first, then your own attributes
solutionExplanation: super() calls the parent class constructor. It must be the first line of the constructor.
